create_symbol_database: create a SymbolDatabase instance with a custom DescriptorPool for registering protobuf symbols
register_message: register a protobuf message class in the SymbolDatabase so GetSymbol can resolve it by name
register_file_descriptor: register a protobuf file descriptor to add all its message types to the symbol database
get_symbol: look up a registered protobuf message class by its fully qualified symbol name
get_messages: get all registered message classes from a list of protobuf file names as a dictionary
